definitions.explanation: A formal expression of disagreement or opposition, especially in legal, parliamentary, or official contexts. Carries a stronger, more formal tone than simply expressing a different opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異議|いぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{立|た}てた→申し立てる：27400_moushitateru⟧。
examples.english: I filed an objection to the verdict.

examples.japanese: {異議|いぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: If there are no objections, I would like to formally approve this proposal.

notes:
USAGE:
{異議|いぎ} is used for formal or official objections, particularly in courtrooms, parliamentary proceedings, and official meetings. The phrase {異議|いぎ}あり is well known from courtroom dramas and the video game series {逆転裁判|ぎゃくてんさいばん} (Ace Attorney).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異議|いぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{立|た}てる→申し立てる：27400_moushitateru⟧ (file an objection)
- {異議|いぎ}あり (objection! — courtroom)
- {異議|いぎ}なし (no objection)
- {異議|いぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧ (raise an objection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異論|いろん}→異論：13551_iron⟧: dissenting opinion (less formal, used in general discussions)
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧: protest (broader, can be physical or public)
- ⟦{意義|いぎ}→意義：00117_igi⟧: significance, meaning (same reading but completely different kanji and meaning)
